title: Yellowed Mellow Polish Fish Pasta
description: A malty, pillowy, indulgent Polish dish featuring shio-koji and yuzu-cure, perfect for pescatarian-friendly meals. This recipe combines the richness of fish with the brightness of citrus.
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and cook the pappardelle pasta according to the package instructions.
In a small bowl, mix together the shio-koji, yuzu juice, and yuzu zest to make the yuzu-cure.
Season the cod fillets with the yuzu-cure and let them marinate for at least 10 minutes.
Melt 2 tbsp of unsalted butter in a large skillet over medium heat and sear the cod fillets until they are cooked through.
Remove the cod from the skillet and set it aside on a plate.
Add the remaining 2 tbsp of unsalted butter to the skillet and stir in the heavy cream.
Bring the cream to a simmer and let it cook until it has reduced by half.
Stir in the grated parmesan cheese until it is melted and the sauce is smooth.
Add the cooked pappardelle pasta to the skillet and toss it in the cheese sauce until it is well coated.
Serve the pasta hot, topped with a piece of cod and a sprinkle of chopped fresh parsley.
